name: The Apothecary's Forgetting
summary: A thread from a companion's past, picked up by someone in Wickermoor.

stages.journal: The Apothecary's Forgetting: something on the train left a thread loose, and it picks up in Wickermoor.
stages.hint: Reach Wickermoor Village and be welcomed.

waits.text: Morgan the apothecary in Wickermoor will take up this thread once the village has welcomed us.

stages.journal: Morgan knows the shape of what we forgot.
